status-bench.fr: 🟣 Développé, entraînement ou bancs d'essai en cours
status-bench.en: 🟣 Built, training or benchmarking in progress

harness-lab.name: HarnessLab
harness-lab.en: Teaching demonstrator that shows, building block by building block, what an agentic harness adds to a bare LLM (reasoning, memory, tools, RAG, MCP, skills, hooks, sub-agents). Runs locally on CPU; French, English and German interface.

frugal-ai-workbench.name: Frugal AI Workbench
frugal-ai-workbench.en: Local and responsible AI workbench: small language model (SLM) demo, advanced RAG and autonomous agents, with Green IT impact measurement (CodeCarbon).

mood-steering-slm.name: Mood Steering SLM
mood-steering-slm.en: Giving a small language model a "mood" such as joy by activation steering at inference time: dosable and reversible, with no weight change, measured against a role-play prompt on tone, accuracy, sycophancy and energy.

nn-weight-writing.name: NN Weight Writing
nn-weight-writing.en: Having an LLM write every weight of a small neural network directly, without training, then comparing it with hand-written rules, standard training, weight editing and activation steering, from rule-based tasks up to grafting written circuits into a small language model.

agent-cost-kit.name: Agent Cost Kit
agent-cost-kit.en: Claude Code plugin for developing with agents without blowing up the bill: role-routed agents, quick end-of-story check, real cost measurement from local transcripts.

charte-generique.name: Charte générique
charte-generique.en: Dark-first design system shipped as a Claude Code plugin: DTCG tokens, theme files for web, Streamlit, Python charts, Office and mermaid, accessibility checks (contrast, colour blindness), and a skill that audits a repository and migrates it to the system.

slm-quality-bench.name: SLM Quality Bench
slm-quality-bench.en: Hard quality benchmark for small local language models (Ollama), in French: two reasoning tracks, anti-contamination, calibrated judge, paired statistics.

slm-weight-editing.name: SLM Weight Editing
slm-weight-editing.en: Fixing small language model defects such as reasoning loops by having Claude edit their weights directly, without training, then measuring gains and regressions on SLM Quality Bench.

service-public-slm-fine-tuning.name: SLM Service Public
service-public-slm-fine-tuning.en: Offline AI assistant for French public sector staff on a 16 GB office PC: fine-tuned small model, local RAG and the official data.gouv MCP server.

usine-migration-jira-demo.name: Copilote Jira
usine-migration-jira-demo.en: Automated reporting and AI copilot for an IT migration factory driven by Jira (fictitious data).

pentest-scribe.name: PentestScribe
pentest-scribe.en: Offline AI assistant for cybersecurity audit consultants on a 16 GB CPU-only laptop: a local small language model drafts vulnerability findings from raw pentest notes, with no data leaving the machine.

librarian-bench.name: LibrarianBench
librarian-bench.en: Benchmark of AI document retrieval architectures (naive and hybrid RAG, GraphRAG, LLM wiki, agentic search) on quality, cost, latency, energy and compliance.

devsecops-dojo.name: DevSecOps Dojo
devsecops-dojo.en: Local teaching app to learn git and GitHub, then the CI/CD chain and DevSecOps, on real offline git with a simulated GitHub; built for vibe coders who need to understand what their agent does to their repository.

claude-code-mods.name: Claude Code Mods
claude-code-mods.en: Mods for the Claude Code interface, installed with one line: diff-replie folds file diffs and shell output into one line and groups consecutive calls of the same kind, keeping the full detail one command away.

roue-du-hasard.name: Roue du hasard
roue-du-hasard.en: Single-file web app (one offline HTML page under 200 KB) that spins a fair wheel to decide who gets a gift: cryptographic draw decided before the animation, accessible, works from file://. Version 1.1 (in development) adds an optional on-device chat to drive the wheel in plain French, through a rules-first cascade backed by small models running locally (decision model and SLM with Ollama); the models only call validated actions and never pick the winner.

eval-dojo.name: EvalDojo
eval-dojo.en: Teaching app to learn how to evaluate generative AI in practice: evaluation pipelines, LLM-as-a-judge, evaluation datasets, RAG and AI search evaluation, and data and evaluation for LLM fine-tuning.

veille-agents-code.name: Veille agents de code
veille-agents-code.en: Tooled market watch on coding agents (Claude Code first): plugins, skills and practices grouped by the problem they solve, compared with native features and checked against research papers and practitioner feedback, with a visual radar and a sourced report.

pilotage-projets.name: Pilotage projets
pilotage-projets.en: Local, personal dashboard that tracks projects and parallel Claude Code sessions across several PCs: session hooks and a per-PC scan feed a local web app that shows the action to take on each project (stable, to stabilise, paused, to restart, to file) and what to resume after a shutdown.
